facts.fact: The Eswatini Payment Switch allows instant transfers between banks and mobile money providers, with eight institutions connected including E-mali, MTN MoMo and InstaCash, per the Central Bank of Eswatini.
The Central Bank of Eswatini says the national Eswatini Payment Switch, live since 11 December 2024, connects banks and mobile wallets and processed 194,000 transactions worth E856 million.
